thread:
maria_pm: Kickoff note: assemble roadmap items for keystore + retention pilot. Priority: exportable evidence bundles, SOC2/ISO mapping, and clear pilot/GA gates. Need owners and measurable launch criteria.

anil_prod: I'll own the product checklist. We should separate two workstreams: keystore integrations (handshake + attestations) and audit-retention (indexing, export, legal-hold).

sam_security: For attestations: require hardware attestation URI for HSM-backed keys, signed nonce challenge, and tamper-evidence metadata in bundle. Also recommend short template for required logs (authn events, key usages).

lee_sre: Ops constraints: searchable retention (fast index) vs deep-archive (cold) is a capacity policy. Proposal: tier A (searchable, 30/90 days), tier B (archive quick-retrieve, 365), tier C (cold long-term, 7yr). Define cost multiplier: A=3x, B=1.5x, C=0.4x relative to baseline.

nina_legal: Legal asks: export controls by jurisdiction, ability to produce signed chain-of-custody, and redaction support for PII during e-discovery exports. Also need clause template for customer contracts that commit to retrieval SLAs.

jules_sales: Field data: two enterprise pockets need WORM + 7yr, but only one requires indexable search. They want demonstrable playbook for evidence requests (SLA + step-by-step).

carlos_cse: Customer side nuance: offline import via secure courier and an online API flow. Also customers expect a clear rollback (managed-key fallback) and a migration path if keys rotate externally.

anil_prod: Draft CSV/manifest schema I'll ask eng to fill: [provider_id, region_policy, import_flow(online|offline), hsm_attestation_uri, algos_supported, rotation_api, allowed_export_formats, retention_tiers, search_indexed_boolean, e_discovery_p95s, cost_multiplier, compliance_notes].

sam_security: Add required_log_fields to the manifest: event_ts, actor_id, operation, key_id, request_id, client_cert_fingerprint.

lee_sre: Suggested SLA targets for launch candidates: evidence-search P95 <= 3s for indexed tiers, cold-restore <= 45s for archive tier, packaged export creation <= 4m for <=2000 records. We'll validate under synthetic 2k qps pattern.

nina_legal: Gating criteria for GA from legal perspective: documented export map per region, redaction toolchain validated, signed-chain-of-custody format approved.

maria_pm: Proposed rollout plan: canary cohort 0.5% (internal), pilot cohort up to 3 customers, expanded pilot 10 customers, GA. Gate for each stage: no sev1/sev2 in 72h, SLAs within 15% of target, and audit bundle format round-trip verified.

carlos_cse: For pilots offer two modes: 1) integration mode (customer manages keys & handshake), 2) audit-only mode (we store event logs but not customer key material). Also include explicit consent for export tests.

jules_sales: I'll compile pilot candidate list and tag deals that need 7yr retention. Also request a short FAQ for sales on SLA tradeoffs/costs.

anil_prod: Action items and owners: Product -> manifest + GA gating doc by Tue (1746086400); Eng -> fill provider matrix + handshake examples by Thu; Security -> attestation template + log spec by Thu; Legal -> export-control mapping and contract clause by Fri; SRE -> perf runbook + cost model by Fri.

infra-bot: Note: compliance release window scheduled next week. Please avoid pushing breaking infra changes during pilot.

lee_sre: Cost modeling note: include per-tenant monthly delta = base_storage_cost * retention_multiplier + indexing_cpu_hours * $0.12. We should produce a sample cost table for the three retention bands.

sam_security: I'll add a short threat checklist: key compromise scenarios, replay/forgery, audit tampering, and mitigation owners.

maria_pm: Good thread. We'll meet Tue 30m after deliverables to review gating checklist. If any blockers emerge, flag in this thread. :white_check_mark:
